prompt: Which PCI DSS v4 requirements that used to be 'future-dated' are mandatory now, and which bite hardest?
assertions: States all future-dated v4.x requirements became mandatory March 31, 2025 (v4.0.1 is the current standard)
Cites password/authentication changes: 12-character minimum passwords and MFA for ALL access into the CDE (8.3.6, 8.4.2)
Cites e-commerce controls: payment page script inventory/authorization/integrity (6.4.3) and change-and-tamper detection (11.6.1)
Mentions others such as automated log review mechanisms, authenticated internal vulnerability scans, and phishing protections
Advises a gap re-check for any assessment performed against pre-2025 practices
